Curly Tales takes you right into the vibrant heart of Bihar's grandest celebration – Chhath Puja! Experience this unique festival dedicated to the Sun God, as the entire state of Bihar decks up, and the ghats come alive with breathtaking rituals and devotion.
This four-day festival is packed with cultural significance.
Day 1: Nahay Khay
The festival begins with purification – a holy dip in the river followed by a simple meal. It’s all about cleansing the body and soul for the days ahead.
